sources.quote: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after software fix, feds say
The update to Waymo's self-driving system was rolled out nearly a year ago.

claims.statement: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after a software fix that was rolled out nearly a year ago.

sources.quote: NHTSA investigates if Waymo robotaxis are still running school bus stop signs
The latest probe questions the effectiveness of Waymo's software recall from 2025.

claims.statement: NHTSA is investigating whether Waymo robotaxis are still running school bus stop signs, questioning the effectiveness of the 2025 recall.

analysis.headline: Feds probe Waymo robotaxis for passing stopped school buses
analysis.summary: Federal regulators say Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing stopped school buses even after a software fix rolled out nearly a year ago, prompting NHTSA to question the effectiveness of Waymo's 2025 software recall.
